dataset: AER practical exercise - synthetic intake records
note: Entirely fabricated. Operators, people, places, phone numbers, and directive references are fictional and do not represent real entities or real regulatory content.

records.raw_text: Ongoing diesel smell near the access road by our quarter. Started maybe Thursday. Not overpowering but my wife has been getting headaches in the evening.

CALLER: yeah there's a truck been idling on the lease road since about six this morning and the dust is unreal, we can't hang laundry. AGENT: is there any spill or leak. CALLER: no just dust and noise.

To whom it may concern. The flare at the battery north of us has been burning bright orange with black smoke intermittently for three nights, roughly 11pm to 2am. This is new behaviour. Photos attached.
records.location_text: approx 3 km N of Wandering Hills

records.raw_text: water in dugout looks rusty

CALLER: I want to report that a crew came onto my land yesterday without any notice at all, no phone call, nothing, and they were surveying near the old wellhead. AGENT: did they identify themselves. CALLER: they had Sablefield on the trucks.
Reporting apparent produced water release at a site near our grazing lease. Ground is stained over an area I would guess 15 by 20 metres. No flowing water nearby. I did not see anyone on site.
records.location_text: N of Twp Rd 502, Rge Rd 15

records.raw_text: CALLER: there's been a loud bang and now a real strong sulphur smell coming off the plant on the east side of the river, my eyes are watering. AGENT: how long ago. CALLER: five, ten minutes maybe.
Noise from compressor station has increased noticeably since the shutdown in August. At night I measure it at about 52 dBA at my deck with a phone app. It was not like this before.
records.location_text: Rge Rd 63, approx 1.2 km from station

records.raw_text: Follow-up on my complaint from June regarding debris and abandoned tubing left on the lease. Nothing has been cleaned up. I was told someone would attend within 30 days.
Dead songbirds, four of them, found around the edge of an open tank on the lease. I have photos. I do not know what is in the tank.

CALLER: I am at 14 Larkspur Bay in Hollow Creek and we keep getting a chemical smell in the basement. This is the first time I have called. AGENT: any symptoms. CALLER: headache, and my daughter says the same.
There is standing fluid in the ditch along the approach to the well site. Cannot tell if it is rain runoff or something else. Sending this so it is on record.
Light pollution from the new pad is severe. Floodlights point directly at our house all night. We have blackout curtains now and it is still bright.

Odour complaint, moderate, intermittent over two days. Please log.

GAS SMELL STRONG BY THE ROAD ALLOWANCE. THIRD TIME THIS MONTH. NOBODY CALLS BACK.
I operate a small feedlot adjacent to the pipeline right of way. Cattle have been agitated and one section of fence along the ROW is down. Suspect the recent integrity dig.
records.location_text: ROW km 14.2, N of Twp Rd 522

records.raw_text: Vent stack noise, high pitched, comes and goes. Worse when wind is from the west. Not an emergency, just constant.
Loud noise then very strong rotten egg smell from the gas plant across the river about half an hour ago. Several of us on this road noticed it at the same time. My throat is scratchy.
Requesting information on the reclamation status of an old site on our quarter. Not a complaint. Who do I speak to.
CALLER: the road has been chewed up by their trucks and now the school bus route is affected. AGENT: have you spoken to the county. CALLER: county says it is their traffic.

AGENT: 24 hour line. CALLER: we have a very strong sour gas smell right through the hamlet, it started maybe fifteen minutes ago, I have had two neighbours call me, one of them says she is dizzy. The elementary school is right here, they have kids outside for lunch break. AGENT: how far is the facility. CALLER: the sour facility is maybe four hundred metres, straight upwind of the school.
records.location_text: Hollow Creek hamlet, approx 400 m downwind of sour facility; elementary school adjacent

records.raw_text: Erosion along the pipeline crossing at the creek has exposed what looks like pipe. Concerned about the next high water.
records.location_text: creek crossing, S of Twp Rd 470

records.raw_text: Dust from the lease road is coating our hay. This has been raised twice. Requesting dust suppression as previously promised.
Saw a contractor dumping what looked like wash water into the ditch at the north end of the pad around 2pm today.
records.location_text: N end of pad, Twp Rd 392

records.raw_text: Second time contacting you about 14 Larkspur Bay in Hollow Creek. The chemical smell in the basement is stronger this week and now my daughter has been off school two days with headaches. Nobody has attended.
CALLER: there is a gate left open on the lease and my horses got out onto the range road. AGENT: any injuries. CALLER: no, we got them back, but it is the third time.

Reporting a small produced water release on our own lease for the record. Approximately 1.4 cubic metres, fully contained inside the bermed area on the pad, recovered by vac truck within the hour. No hydrocarbon sheen, no watercourse within 900 m, no wildlife contact, no H2S. Operator internal reference NR-2026-4471.
Snow fence and signage around the abandoned wellhead has fallen over. Kids ride quads through there.
records.location_text: quarter section W of Rge Rd 82

records.raw_text: Our well water has changed taste and there is a slight fizz. The nearest activity is the new drilling about 1.5 km away. I would like it tested.

I am writing about my daughter Amelie Sorensen, she is 14, we live at 8812 Ravenscrag Road in Hollow Creek. Since the flaring started she has needed her rescue inhaler most days and her respirologist at the children's clinic has asked us to keep a symptom log, which I have attached below. Her health card number is on the log, sorry, I just photographed the page. I want this on the record because I intend to pursue it.

[log excerpt] Sept 8 - two puffs am, wheeze at night. Sept 9 - three puffs. Sept 11 - kept home from school. Sept 12 - clinic visit, dose increased.
Reporting heavy equipment operating outside permitted hours, 5:15 am starts three days running.
CALLER: the smell is back. AGENT: which location. CALLER: same as before. AGENT: I do not have your previous file, can you give me the location. CALLER: [call disconnected]
There is an oily sheen on the slough downstream of the battery. Approximately 40 by 10 metres of visible sheen. Waterfowl present on the slough.
records.location_text: slough S of battery, Twp Rd 448

records.raw_text: Fence damaged by drilling traffic. Minor. Just want it fixed before winter.

CALLER: I want to complain about the gravel trucks going through town at six in the morning, they are shaking the windows and one of them took out my mailbox. AGENT: are these trucks associated with an energy facility. CALLER: no, they are going to the new subdivision development on the south side. AGENT: understood. CALLER: well somebody has to do something.
records.location_text: town of Hollow Creek, main street

records.raw_text: Requesting a copy of the emergency response plan for the sour facility near our acreage, as a resident inside the notification zone.
Steady venting sound and visible vapour from a tank on the lease for the past two hours. No smell that I can detect from the road.

Cattle drinking from a dugout adjacent to the lease. Two animals have died this week. Vet suspects poisoning but cannot confirm source. I want the dugout tested and I want to know what is stored on that pad.
